meta.title: An awarded event: "Withdraw" is greyed out and says why

steps.note: Open the API-prepared awarded event on the buyer's summary page.
Navigate to the RFQ stage named in the case.
Open the RFQ Responses sub-tab before accessing its Settings menu.
Assert that Withdraw is present but disabled and that its explanatory tooltip is shown.
Reopen the Settings menu so the disabled Withdraw item can be directly tested.
Try the greyed-out Withdraw control and verify that it does not open a dialog or cause a change.
